༄༅/ /dbang don mdor bsdus bstan pa gsal byed yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbang don mdor bsdus bstan pa gsal byed yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ thog mar dal 'byor thob par dka' ba dang*/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang las rgyu 'bras kyi chos rnams bshad la| de nas dbang gi mdor bsdus pa 'di tsam gcig bshad la/ de nas cho ga la 'jug par bya'o/ /de yang 'di skad ces bstan par bya ste/ 'o na da ma yengs par khyod kyi rna ba gtod la legs par nyon cig de yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i ched du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos mnyan la nyams su blang snyam ba'i thugs bskyed re mdzad par zhu/ de yang rang cag rnams thog ma med pa'i dus nas ma rig pa'i dbang gis las sna tshogs bsags nas rigs drug tu 'khor ba yin te| rigs drug po de gang du skyes kyang nad pa'i sngas bzhin sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa bde ba skad cig tsam yang med de/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'khor ba skye shi thog mtha' med/ /der 'gro'i lam ni rnam pa lnga/ / mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med/ /de bzhin lam lnga dag na'ang bde ba med/ /ces gsungs/ ris drug po der skye ba'i rgyu yang*/ sems can rnams kyi thog ma med pa'i dus nas/ rang gi sems nyid rig pa dri ma med pa 'di ngo bo ni stong*/ rang bzhin ni gsal/ stong pa'i rang rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba gcig yin pa la/ de rang gis rang ma rig rang gis rang ma rtogs te sems nyid nga med pa la ngar bzung*/ bdag med pa la bdag du bzung nas/ yid g.yo ba skad cig mas/ de ma thag pa'i rkyain byas te/ bzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog glo bur du lang ste/ las sna tshogs bsag nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa yin/ 'o na de las thar bar byed pa'i thabs gcig yod dam snyam na/ de ni shin tu yang yod de| lam log pa mu stegs byed kyi chos ma yin pa/

bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i yang dag pa'i chos pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i don nyams su blang na/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal kyi rgya mtsho chen po de las thar nas/ bde ba chen po sangs rgyas nyid 'thob pa yin te/ rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ theg pa chen po cher byung ba/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyod rnams der ni dongs pas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /zhes so/ 'o na pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags 'di gnyis kyi khyad par de ci lta bu zhig yin/ lam gang gis nye snyam na/ rtaugs bya gnas lugs kyi don de bzhin nyid dang gcig thob par bya ba 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang gnyis/ thob par byed pa'i thabs/ sems bskyed dang gsum po de pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags gnyis ka la yod par don gcig kyang*/ de rang rgyud la bskyed par byed pa la gsang sngags rdo rje thig pa 'di/ thabs bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ rtaugs par bya ba'i lta ba la ma rmongs pa dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs mang ba dang*/ dka' tshegs med par byang chub 'grub pa dang*/ myur du byang chub 'grub pas dbang po rnon ba dang bzhi yin te/ su ti de nyid 'dus paka ra legs pa sgrub pa'i rgyud las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas te| |sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ 'o na do nub kyi chos 'di gsang sngags dang phar phyin gang yin snyam na/ spyir chos la phyi pa mu stegs kyi chos dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos zhes grub mtha' phyi nang gnyis yod pa las/ do nub 'dir ston pa'i chos 'di ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos yin/ 'di la yang theg pa chen po'i chos dang*/ theg pa chung ngu'i chos gnyis yod pa las/

'di theg pa chen po'i chos yin/ 'di la yang pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa gnyis yod pa las/ 'di gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ 'di la yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud*/ rnal 'byaur bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi yod pa las/ 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ 'di la yang thabs gtso bor ston pa pha bla na med pa'i rgyud dang*/ shes rab gtso bor ston pa ma bla na med pa'i rgyud dang*/ thabs dang shes rab cha mnyam par ston pa cha mnyam kyi rgyud dang*/ gsum yod pa las/ dang po pha bla na med pa'i rgyud la yang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gshin rje nag gshin rje dmar/ khro bo gdong drug khro bo rta mgrin gyi rgyud la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ ma bla na med pa'i rgyud la yang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog dgyes pa rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ ma ha ma ya/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ pad ma zab pa/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ cha mnyam gyi rgyud la yang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ /kyai rdo rje/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ da res cha mnyam kyi rgyud kyi nang tshan/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar byed pa'i skabs yin no/ / de la spyir theg pa che chung dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lam thams cad bslab pa gsum gyis 'jug dgos te/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten lta bu yin/ de la brten nas ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa sems rtsai gcig tu gnas pa dang*/ des shes rab kyi bslab pa la zhugs nas/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pas chos nyid kyi don mngon sum du byas nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'thob pa yin no/ /des na gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di la yang*/ dang po gzhi ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang*/

smin pa grol bar byed pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ grol ba mthar phyin par byed pa dam tshig dang*/ spyod pa gsum yod pa las/ dang po dbang bskur ba/ dam tshig dang*/ spyod pa dang bcas pa de/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin la/ 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bsgrub pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa yin cing*/ de nyid kyang*/ phyi'i 'jig rten| nang lus/ gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsum ye shes su sbyor ba'i thabs yongs su gyur pa ston pa ni shes rab kyi bslab pa yin te/ de'i nang nas kyang gsang sngags zab mo'i chos ston pa'i snod du rung bar byed pa la thog mar tshul khrims kyi bslab par dbang bskur bar byed pa gal che ste/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ dang por re shig slob ma la/ dbang rnams legs par bskur ba dang*/ /de tshe gsang chen bshad par bya/ /nges par snod du gyur pa'o/ / zhes bya ba dang/ rnal 'byor gsum gy-i snying po bstan pa las kyang*/ dbang gi smin byas dam tshigs ldan/ /de la rnal 'byor gsum bstan ste/ /gzhan la nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsung pa dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las kyang*/ seṅge dkar mo'i 'o ma de/ /rin chen snod du ma gtogs pa/ /snod ngan khams sa'i nang blug na/ snod kyang chag la 'o ma 'bo/ /de bzhin snod ngan gang zag la/ /zab mo'i gdam pa stan gyur na/ /don mi go la log lta skye/ / zhes gsungs/ 'o na dbang ma thob pa la gsang sngags kyi chos bstan na skyon ci yod snyam na/ tshe 'dir/ grub chen brgyad dang las chen bcu gnyis la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub cung zad tsam thob kyang*/ skye ba phyi mar dpon slob gnyis ka dmyal bar skye bar bshad de/ phyag rgya chenapo thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang med pa la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir la mar med bzhin/

/gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag |dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis| |bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nyi ma 'khor lo'i rgyud las kyang*/ bla ma mnyes par ma byas shing*/ /dbang rnams thob par ma byas na// nyan pa la sogs rtsaum pa ni/ /'bras bu med cingabarlag par 'gyur/ /bde bas 'bad de nan tan bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpal rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rgyud las/ thog mar slob ma gang gi tshe/ /blo ldan yang dag dbang bskur na/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /de'i tshe na snod du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyud mchog gyi dang por yang*/ dbang bskur med par sngags 'chad dang*/ /zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa/ /don de legs par shes na yang*/ /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba min| |zhes dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba las kyang*/ dbang bskur gy-is ni dben gyur na| |bsgrub pos rgyud kyi don shes kyang*/ /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs pas ni// mi zad dmyal ba chen por 'gro/ /zhes so/ /'o na dbang bskur ba'i bla ma de la ci lta bu gcig dgos snyam na/ spyir bla ma'i mtshan nyid mdo rgyud rnams nas du ma zhig gsungs shing*/ da res gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'dir dbang bskur bar byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ rang nyid kyi dbang thob cing phyag rgya chen po'i don bsgom pa dang*/ phyi nang gzhan gsum de kho na nyid ston pa'i shes rab dang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa gcig dgos te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid can/ /rdo rje theg pa la gnas shing*/ de nyid bhem shing 'dod pa chung*| |chags sogs dri bral bzod brtson 'grus/ /lam zhugs slob mar ster byed pa/ /dmyal ba'i 'jigs 'joms tshangs par spyod/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje'i dbyug pa de/

/sa steng rdo rje 'dzin par grags/ /zhes gsung pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ brtan shing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo sgyu med| |sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtser ldan shing bstan bcos mkhas| |de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas| |sngags nas bshad pa'i spyod pa shes/ /rab tu zhi zhing dbang po dul// de ltar yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma slob mas bstan par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsung pa ltar/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma bsten dgos/ de las 'thob pa ni bla ma mchog yin cing*/ de nyid de nyid bcu ni ā li kā li'i rgyud las| dkyil 'khor de nyid cho ga'i de nyid dang*/ /phyag rgya gar dang tshogs 'khor de nyid dang*/ /rdo rje dril bu phreng ba rus pa'i rgyan/ /rtsa ba rang gi de nyid shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ bcu shes pa'i dge slong ni bla ma rab/ dge tshul ni 'bring*/ khyim pa ni tha ma yin pas/ sa ma thob pa'i khyim pa la bla mar bya mi rung ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shes pa/ /dge slong mchog yin ste| 'bring ni dge tshul nyid du brjod/ khyim na gnas pa tha mar gsungs/ sa thob ma gtogs khyim pa la/ bla ma ru ni mi bya'o/ khyim pas gtsug lag khang dkor spyod/ /gzhan gy-i g.yog dang zhing las dang/ /tshong dang dam chos 'tshong ba dang*| |rmongs pa sa steng rdor 'dzin min/ /zhes gsungs/ de las gzhan yang thos bsam bhem gsum gy-i shes rab mi ldan/ spro thung zhing rgyud rtsub/ g.yo sgyu che zhing 'dod yon la zhen/ de ltar bu'i bla ma de dmyal ba bzhin du spang bar bya dgos te/ rtsa rgyud las/ nga rgyal khro dang dam tshig bral/ /rdzas la brkam dang thos pa med/ /slob ma bslu ba don du gnyer/ /mchog tu bde ba'i go 'phang nyams| |bdag nyid dbang gis ma smin dang*/ /bag med pa dang tshig rtsub bcas| |dbang po'i don du 'dod la dga'/

/slob ma byang chub don gnyer bas| |dmyal ba bzhin du de spang bya/ /zhes gsung pa dang bsdus pa'i rgyud las| nga rgyal khro ba mngon du gyur cing dam tshig rnam par bral la rdzas la bskam shing thos pa med/ /slob ma rnams ni bslu ba don gnyer mchog du bde ba'i go 'phang sems nyams dbang ma thob pa dang*/ /longs spyod la chags bag med tshig rtsub dang bcas dbang po'i don du 'dod pa la dga' ba/ /slob ma rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i mkhas pas dmyal ba bzhin du de ni spang bar bya ba kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na slob mas bla ma brtag na skyon brtag pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ thog mar bla ma brtag pa ni/ skyon tshol ba dang glan ka tshol ba ma yin pas nyes pa med/ ci ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub dag /slob dpon zhal gy-i rjes 'brang bar/ /ma lus rdo rje theg pa'i rgyu// rnam par thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ /de phyir slom mas bla ma rnams/ / bsreg bcad brdar bas gser bzhin du/ /yongs su brtag na sd-ig pas ni/ / cung zad gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de/ slob ma ci ltar bu gcig gis bsten par bya snyam na/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ bla ma la dad cing rgyud la gus pa dang*/ shes rab dang snying rje che ba dang*/ zab mo'i don la mos shing thar pa don du gnyer ba gcig dgos te/ bsdus rgyud las/ zab dang rgya che'i sems nyid bla ma'i nges pa la dga' gtong dang tshul khrims yon tan can shes pa/ /thar pa don gnyer rgyud la gus dang sems mi g.yo dang de nyid thob pa shin tu sbed pa dang*/ /gdug pa can kyi grogs po spang pa'i slob ma de nyid shin tu mkhas pa'i bla mas bzung bar bya/ / shes rab dbang bskur la sogs phyi dang gzhan zhes bya dang yang ni bar ma bsod nams don du'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ pad zab pa'i rgyud las kyang*/ dad pa gsum dang ldan pa dang*/

/bla ma la gus mnyam par lta/ /shes rab ldan zhing snying rje che/ /rtag tu chos la spyod pa dang*/ gsang sngags the tshom med pa dang*/ / yid ches tshad ma skyes pa dang*/ /mang du blo gros sbyangs pa dang*/ /nges pa'i don la 'jug pa dang*/ /'khor ba skyon du lta ba dang*/ /lha la spong len mi byed pa'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ /mtshan nyid de rnams dang mi ldan pa'i slob ma la dbang sbyin par mi rung ste/ bde mchog dur khrod rgyan rmad du byung ba'i rgyud las/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug khong shing chags la tshul khrims med/ /dad med rigs ngan slob ma'i skyon/ /thos chung snying ring rnams la spang*/ /zhes so/ /de rnams la bstan na skyon ci yod snyam na/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur te/ yang de nyid las/ phyi rabs dus kyi snyigs ma la/ /chags sems gyong ba'i slob ma ni/ /gus pas mi zhu g.yo sgyu 'dod/ /thos nas khung sbub rang che sbyin/ /de la bstan na dam tshig nyams| |zhes so/ /yang slob ma dad pa dang ldan pa la ma gnang na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rigs brgyud chad pas gnang dgos te/ yang de nyid las/ nges par dad nas zhu ba yi/ /gcig las gnyis las ma bstan na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rigs brgyud chad/ /ces so/ / 'o na rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bla mar skyon dang yon tan 'dres par gnas pas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dkon na ci ltar bya snyam na/ yon tan shas che ba'i bla ma de bsten par bya dgos te/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i zhal nas/ rtsod pa'i dus 'di ru/ nyon mongs rnams rgyas dbang gi ni| |slob dpon skyon dang yon tan 'dres/ /dge ba rnams bsten yon tan dag| shas cher gyur pa rnam par bzung*/ /ces bya'o/ /'o na slob ma des bla ma de ci ltar bsten snyam na/ bla ma'i skyon mi brtag par yon tan la lta zhing bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed cing*/ zang zing gi 'bul ba dang*/ lus ngag gi zhabs tog dang*/ sgrub pa'i sgo nas bla ma'i thugs mnyes par bya dgos te/

bla ma'i yon tan yongs su bzung ba'i rgyud las/ rgyal bas bka' stsal snyigs ma'i tshe/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon tan bzung*/ /skyon ni nam yang ma yin no// yon tan bzung bas dngos grub 'gyur/ /skyon brjod pas ni dngos grub med// chu la 'o ma rab zhugs pa/ /de gton nas ni ngang pas btung*/ /de ltar bla ma'i yon tan bzung*/ /'dir mang smos pas ci zhig bya/ /bla ma'i thugs dgyes thams cad bya/ /mi dgyes thams cad spang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang bla ma brnyas pa dang ma gus pa'i yan lag thams cad spang dgos te/ rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma mnyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon brnyas nas ni/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob gyur pas/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na bla ma des slob ma la bskur ba'i dbang de ci lta bu yin snyam na/ dbang 'di la don drug ste/ dbang gi ngo bo ni/ rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa ste/ dbang mdor bstan las/ dang po'i dbang bdun gang yin pa/ /byis pa rnams ni 'jug phyir ro/ /rnam gsum 'jig rten kun rdzob pa/ /bzhi pa yang ni don dam nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dbang gi mtshan nyid ni/ dri ma sel byed lam gy-i gzhi khyad par can no| |gsum pa dbang gi sgra don ni/ a bhi ṣiñca zhes pa'i sgra la/ a bi ṣiñca shā da zhes pa gtor ba ste/ sgrib pa 'thor bar byed pas na dbang*/ a bi ṣe ka twad ces pa blug pa ste/ yon tan 'jog par byed pas na dbang zhes bya ba yin te| he badz+ra las/ gtor dang blug pa zhes bya 'dis/ /des na dbang zhes brjod par bya| |zhes gsungs so/ /dbang mdor bstan pa las kyang dbang bskur bdun po mi'i bdag /lus ngag yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /dbang bskur ba ni gnyis gnyis so/ /rjes gnang ye shes dag byed 'gyur/ /mngon par dbang bskur 'di gsum gyis/ /lus ngag yid ni dag byed cing*/

/bzhi pa ye shes dag byed pa// lus ngag yid kyang dag byed dang*/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa dbang gi grangs nges ni/ bsdus na sbyang gzhi bzhi yod pa la/ sbyong byed kyi dbang yang bzhir grangs nges te/ lus kyi dri ma sbyong zhing*/ lus rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyong ba la bum pa'i dbang*/ ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong zhing*/ rtsa rgyud drod kyi shes rab 'bar bar byed pa la gsang ba'i dbang*/ yid kyi sgrib pa sbyong shing bde ba'i rang bzhin zag med kyi lam du bsgyur bar byed pa la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sems kyi dri ma sbyong zhing*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs par byed pa la bzhi pa tshig dbang dang bzhir grangs nges pa yin te| ā li kā li gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ lus kyi sgrib pa sbyar phyir bum pa'i dbang/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i zhing du byin gyis rlobs| |gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rtsa rgyud drod kyi shes rab 'bar bar byed/ /gsum pa'i dbang gis yid kyi sgrib pa dag /bde ba'i rang bzhin zag med lam du zhugs/ /bzhi pa'i dbang gis sems kyi sgrib pa dag/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs par byed/ /ces so/ /dbang bzhi po yang dbye na bcu gnyis yod de/

de yang sbyang gzh-i bcu gnyis yod pas/ sbyong byed kyi dbang yang bcu gnyis su grangs nges pa yin te/ de yang ma'i mngal na gnas pa'i gnas skabs kyi rtog pa reg pa sra ba la sogs pa rnams ni sbyang bya yin/ sbyong byed sta gon gyi chos rnams kyis sbyang pas/ thob bya tshogs lam dang sbyor lam kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas skyes nas mas byis pa'i lus dkru ba'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed chu'i dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'i bag chags sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /yang byis pa'i dus na/ gtsug phud 'jog pa'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed cod pan kyi dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i bag chags sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /yang byis pa'i dus na rna ba 'bug cing rgyan 'dogs pa'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed dar 'phyang gi dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa gsum pa 'od byed pa'i bag chags sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /yang byis ba'i dus na lus kyi spyod pa slob pa'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed rdo rje dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /yang byis pa'i dus na ngag gi smra ba slob pa'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /yang byis ba'i dus na ming 'dogs pa'i dus gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed ming gi dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas yang byis ba'i dus su/ rang gi rigs dang longs spyod la ngo sprod pa'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed rjes gnang gi dbang bskur bas/

thob bya sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de rnams ni byis pa'i gnas skabs kyi rtog pa bdun sbyong ba'i chos yin pas na/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhes bya'o/ /de skyes bu dar la bab pa'i tshe/ lo drug lon pas thig le rdzogs pa'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed dkar 'dzin bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas khyim thab len ba'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed gsang ba'i dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no| |de nas 'khyud pas 'dzag pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bas blo rmongs pa'i rtog pa gcig yod/ de dag bya yin/ dag byed shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ thob bya sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas 'chi ba dang sems med pa'i gnas skabs gcig yod| de dag bya yin/ dag byed bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur bas/ thob bya thar pa'i lam sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon kyi dbang bskur bas/ 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de ltar yin par yang*/ kyai'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'bum lnga las/ byis pa skye ba ma yis ni/ /chu'i dbang ni bskur byed cing*/ /de'i gtsug phud 'jog pa dag /cod pan du ni rab tu btags/ /de'i rna ba 'bug la sogs/ /dar dpyang dbang bskur yin zhes bya| |byis pa smra dang brtaig pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu'i dbang bskur yin/ /de bzhin ming gi dbang bskur ba'o/ /rjes su gnang ba pha yis ni/ /rtag tu klaug sogs sbyin ba'au/ /de ltar dbang ni bdun du grags/ /de'i chung ma len byed pa//

dbang ni gong ma yin par brjod/ /de'i shes rab byin pa ni/ /lag pa nas ni 'dzin par byed/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms zhugs nas/ /phyi mtha'i bde ba nyams su myong*/ /zhes rdo rje snying pos brtag gnyis 'grel pa las gsungs so// de ltar byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun ni ma dag sa bdun dang mchog stai dbang gsum gyis ni dag pa sa gsum gyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la 'jog pa yin pa yang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ dbang bdun rnams kyi dbang bskur bas ni dge ba'i dbang gis sa bdun dbang phyug du 'gyur ro/ /slar yang phyir mi ldaug pa la sogs par yang bum pa gsang ba'i dbang bar yang nges par 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab ye shes dbang bskur bas ni srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje thod kyi rgyud las kyang*/ dbang bcu sa bcu bgrod nas ni/ /de yi bde bas sangs rgyas gyur/ /zhes so/ /de dbang gi grangs nges yin/ da lnga pa dbang gi go rim nges pa ni/ dang po ma'i mngal du lus grub pa'i tshe/ thog mar khams lnga grub la/ de nas phung po lnga/ de nas skye mched bcu gnyis/ de nas las kyi dbang po/ de nas 'dzag pa'i bde ba dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi rim gyis 'grub pas| de rnams sbyong byed rnams kyang chu'i dbang nas rim pa bzhin 'byung ba yin te/ de yang khams lnga rigs kyi yum lnga'i rang bzhin du gdod ma nas gnas pa de/ chu'i dbang bskur bas khams lnga'i rtog pa sbyangs te/ rigs kyi yum lnga'i rang bzhin du 'gyur/ cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas phung po lnga'i rtog pa sbyang ste/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ dar 'phyang gi dbang bskur bas/ rlung bcu'i rtog pa sbyong ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ngo bo nus ma bcu'i rang bzhin du 'gyur/ rdo rje dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ thig le dkar dmar gnyis kyi rtog pa sbyang ste/ thabs shes rab kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur/

brtul shugs kyi dbang bskur bas/ skye mched bcu gnyis kyi rtog pa sbyang ste/ sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /ming gi dbang bskur bas/ las kyi dbang po dang de'i bya ba rnams sbyang ste/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du 'gyur| rjes gnang gi dbang bskur bas ye shes kyi khams sbyang ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur te/ dbang mdor bstan las/ chu'i khams ni kun nges sbyong*/ /cod pan phung po rnam sbyong ba/ /dar dpyang pha rol phyin pa dag /rdo rje dril bu mi 'gyur che/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni rgyun mi chad/ / nyi zla gcig nyid sbyong byed pa/ /rdo rje brtul zhugs mi 'gyur ba/ /yul dang dbang po kun sbyong yin/ /ming ni bya sogs legs sbyong ba/ /rjes gnang sangs rgyas nyid sbyong bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun po 'di ni phyi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor gyi steng nas bskur ba yin ste/ dbang mdor bstan las/ de ltar dbang ni bdun po 'di/ /dkyil 'khor bris la sbyin par bya| |zhes so/ /de nas 'jig rten pa'i mchog gi dbang gsum ni/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsum yin te/ de gsum kyi ngo bo/ nges don ni/ shes rab ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ nu ma la reg pas bde ba skye ba ni/ dkar 'dzin bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i nges don yin la/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ phyag rgya yi gsang gnas mnyes pas bde ba cher skyes pa de/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i nges don yin zhing*/ sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab dang snyom par zhugs pa las/ bde ba'i ye shes shin tu cher nyams su myong ba de/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i nges don yin te/ dbang mdor bstan las/ shes rab yan lag nu mar ni/ /reg pas byang chub sems 'phos te/ /gang phyir byis pas bde thob pa/ /dkar 'dzin gyi ni de dbang bskur|

|gsang ba yun ring mnyes la skyes/ /byang chub sems 'pho bde ba ste// gang phyir gsang las bde thob pas/ /dar ma de la gsang dbang bskur/ /yun ring pags pa mnyes las skyes/ rdo rje rtse mor 'dzag la bde/ /gang phyir rgan po'i 'dzag gyur pas/ /shes rab ye shes de dbang bskur/ /ces gsungs so/ / de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bcu gcig pa 'di la/ la la dag na re/ gsang 'dus las/ bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang yin no/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang*/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang/ dpal kha sbyor las kyang*/ dang po bum pa'i dbang yin te/ /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang*/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ / bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ he badz+ra las kyang/ slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang*/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ / dbang gsum pa'i don la tshig gis nges pa bskyed pa dang*/ dbang bzhi pa yin zer ba ni ma yin te/ dbang gsum pa ni bud med la sogs pa la brten nas thig le 'pho ba'i bde ba yin pa'i phyir dang*/ dbang bzhi pa ni stong pa nyid rnam par mi rtog pa la brten nas thig le mi 'pho ba'i bde ba chen po yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis gcig ma yin te/ dbang mdor bstan las/ 'gyur zhing 'gyur te de nas 'dzag /de nas gzhan du 'dzag pa med/ /ces pa'o/ /he badz+ra las kyang*/ gang phyir 'byung ba che bde ba/ /de phyir bde ba de nyid min/ /zhes gsungs so/ / 'o na spyan ras gzigs kyis dus 'khor gyi 'grel pa las/ dbang gsum pa'i dbang po gnyis kyi sbyong ba las/ byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba'i dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang dga' bral kyi dbus su thig le gsum pa'i mthar 'dod pa'i skad cig ma 'dir kun tu bzang po bde ba de nyid rang rig pa zhes bya ba dang*/ he badz+ra las kyang*/ mchog dga' dga' bral dang por ni/

/mun pa las ni mar me ltar/ /de bzhin nus kyang yid ches kyi/ /zhes gsung nas bskyed pa de bzhi pa yin par bshad pa dang*/ 'gal ce na/ de ni gsum pa'i don la tshig gi nges pa mchog dga'am mtha' dga' bral kyi yang mthar dar dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'am/ bde stong gi nyams 'char ba de dpe'i ye shes yin par gsung pa yin zhing/ don kyi ye shes yin par gsung pa ni ma yin te/ dus 'khor kyi 'grel pa las/ las kyi phyag rgya'i bde ba la/ kun tu bzang po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar mi 'gyur te/ phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes nyams pa phug nyid du byed pa la sangs rgyas nyid med de/ phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes med pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal sa ra ha pas kyang*/ ma lus rang bzhin gang gis mi shes pa/ /kun tu rgyu'i dus su bde chen bsgrub pa ni/ /ci ltar skom nas snyigs tu bsnyag pa bzhin/ /skom nas shi yang nam mkha'i chu snyed dam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs spangs la/ /ye shes phyag rgya rnam dag dor/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur rnal 'byor pas/ phyag rgya chen po bhem par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na dbang bzhi pa rang gi ngo bo de ci ltar bu gcig yin snyam na/ bla mas phyag rgya chen po'i gdam ngag bstan te/ bzung 'dzin gyi rlung dbus su bcug thig le g.yo ba med par byas nas/ bde stong dbyer med kyi don nyams su myong ba de/ dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rgyu mthun pa/ nas kyis nas kyi 'bras bu 'byin pa lta bu yin te/ dbang mdor bstan las/ phyag rgya chen po'i rjes chags las/ /rgyu mthun log pa bde ba dag /gang phyir rgyu mthun nyid du 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen pos de dbang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rjes chags las/ skyes pa gang nas bde ba ni/ /ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur ro/

/zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar dbang bcu yod pa las/ mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa dbang gong ma rnams sbyin gyis/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang bsod nams kho na 'dod pa rnams la byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun las/ mi sbyin cing*/ slob dpon du 'os pa ma yin pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang yang mi sbyin par bshad/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ shes rab ye shes dbang bskur la sogs phyi nang gzhan zhes bya dang*| yang ni bar ma bsod nams don du'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar dbang zhus nas yon ma phul na/ dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes ltung thams cad 'byung bas/ yon gyis bla ma mnyes par bya ste/ gsang 'dus las/ dbang yon ma phul shin tu nyams/ /des na dbang yon 'bul ba ni/ /byin rlabs dbang ni bla ma la/ /rgyal srid yul 'khor rang gi lus/ /bu dang chung ma nor dbyig 'bul| |zhes gsungs so/ /'o na dbang de lta bu longs spyod med pa'i slob mas zhu mi phod snyam na/ yang dag pa'i lam la 'jug cing bsgrub pa tshul bzhin byed pa'i slob ma la ni/ longs spyod kyi 'byor pa med kyang*/ dbang rnams tshig gi sbyin pas chog la/ longs spyod dang 'byor pa yod pa rnams la ni mar me'i mchod pa dang gtor ma med pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la yon ma phul bar dbang sbyin du mi rung bar bshad/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ longs spyod med pa'i a ba dhu ti la ni dbang bskur rgyal ba'i bdag po'i tshig gis sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin du ba la sogs lam dang ma lus yon tan rtsa'i sbyor bar bcas pa dang*/ / bsten pa'i don du lag pa'i phyag rgya rang gis sems kyi dbang du son pas kun snyom rnam par brel/ /gzhan du mar me'i mchod pa dman la rgyal ba mchog gi snying po 'di ni sbyin par bya ba min/ /zhes so/ / de rnams dbang spyi'i go ba bskyed pa bsdus pa tsam yin/ da ni dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dngos ston par byed pa yin/

'di la yang*/ sta gon kyi cho gdangos gzhi'i cho ga 'jug gi cho ga gsum du yod pa las/ sta gon kyi cho ga ston par byed pa yin/ /zhes pa nas cho ga'i rim pa bzhin bya'o/ /cho ga lha so so'i dbang gi cho ga ltar bya'o/ /dbang don mdor bsdus bstan pa 'di/ /chos smra shes rab rin chen gyis/ /sgrub gnas dkar ma'i dgon par sbyar/ /dge bas 'gro kun dbang don rtogs par shog/rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/dbang don mdor bsdus bstan pa gsal byed yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ -PAGE 324--PAGE 325-- PAGE 320-
